tagline_en: Lightweight anti-glycation oil for smooth, supple skin
tagline_zh: 轻盈不油腻 · 抑制AGS形成 · 光滑弹润细腻
overview_en: A luxurious blend of plant oils that locks in nutrients and boosts nourishment and softness for a radiant glow; a dual natural antioxidant that inhibits AGEs formation (anti-glycation), dispels sallowness and refines rough skin.
overview_zh: 精油帮助锁住营养，加强滋润与柔嫩，令肌肤更有光泽；双重天然强效抗氧化剂，抑制AGEs形成，抗糖祛黄，改善粗糙，细嫩肌肤。
how_to_use_en: As the final step of your routine, apply to lock in nutrients and moisture.
how_to_use_zh: 护理最后一步，帮助锁住营养与滋润
claims_flagged: 提供抗糖化，同时加强皮肤屏障，减少皮肤发炎的机会
